The drawing is a benzene ring with these substituents, read around the ring:

- C1 (top) carries NH2.
- C2 (upper left) carries F.
- C3 (lower left) carries F.
- C4 (bottom) carries F.
- C5 (lower right) carries H.
- C6 (upper right) carries NO2.

This is 2,3,4-trifluoro-6-nitroaniline, written as the SMILES Nc1c(F)c(F)c(F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-].

Check against the drawing: the ring atoms in that string are C1 (N), C2 (F), C3 (F), C4 (F), C5 (H) and C6 (NO2), which matches the substituent list above.

SMILES: Nc1c(F)c(F)c(F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]
